about: Grades for persona and organization pairs that the reviewers of personas.json and dev2.json never graded, added so that both sides of a comparison are scored on the same judgments (pooling, as TREC does). On 2026-10-22 the top ten of each compared version, for every dev, dev2 and test persona, were pooled, and each pair with no grade and not in wrong_top5 was graded blind by a grader who saw the persona, the earlier grades and notes for calibration, the official listing, and, when unsure, the organization's 2026 ideas page. Graders never saw a ranking or which version surfaced an organization. Same scale as the original grades; 0 is listed too. See evals/README.md.
